profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Route
profile.summary:
I'm a polyglot with a true love for building web applications and services. I write code in Go, Ruby, PHP, TypeScript/Node, and Java, which enables me to pick the best tool for every job and—more importantly—to view things in the perspectives afforded by different languages and platforms. I can package up applications in containers with Docker and configure Kubernetes resources to run them. I originally wanted to be a network engineer and have taken CISCO CCNA classes, so I'm knowledgable and passionate about networks and DevOps as well.

I soak up new information like a sponge and pride myself on mastering new technical skills. My knowledge is varied and spans a wide array of subject matter, and I love adding to that collection. My mind works incredibly analytically, and I love looking at all sides of a problem, collecting as much data as possible, then making creative connections between the data, business logic, and user experiences to come up with the best solution possible. I am not satisfied learning just a part of the system and have no hesitation diving into the other parts in order to synthesize that understanding into a coherent picture of systems in their entirety.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St. Petersburg, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description: With change comes opportunity, and developments in the business presented opportunities for me to mentor more junior engineers and take on more autonomy and agency in regard to engineering our applications. My role as an individual contributor was continued and I also took a more proactive stance on helping spread proprietary knowledge across the Engineering Team and lead by example.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: The promotion to senior-level engineer came rather quickly after beginning at the company after my familiarity with PHP and Laravel was proven. Due to my successful migration of our local development environment, I was offered a position in the Engineering Operations department, which I accepted. I gained quite a bit of experience with AWS services and Kubernetes. Eventually I moved back to Software Engineering due to the lack of opportunity to achieve flow states in DevOps. I believe that I am more creative and happy when I can code within a state of flow, and missed that opportunity, which was my primary reason for moving back. I continued to hone my skills with PHP/Laravel and was also occasionally involved in Go microservice development in which I could utilize my prior Go experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Starting as a mid-level engineer due to outdated PHP experience, I proved that I adapt to any given stack quickly, as evidenced by the short term of this position before being promoted to a senior-level engineer. This job involved a wide array of technologies. The main stack was Laravel for backend operations and Vue for the frontend. I was successful in migrating the (rather complex) local development environment for all engineers to a Docker environment. I also added LaunchDarkly integration for addition of feature flags to our platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description: Focused on building out multi-tenant static website templates and the rendering engine used, I was the leader for a team of five at its highest point, responsible for ensuring that lists of hundreds of client websites could be generated based off of individual templates. Much of this work focused around proprietary template generation using React HTML rendering capabilities.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer in Test
positions.description: Responsible for planning, implementing, and maintaining automated software testing systems for a large-scale multitenant SaaS platform, evangelizing best practices for testing, and writing test plans and cases to automatically ensure proper functionality and uptime of multiple software systems across a myriad cloud applications.

positions.title: Server Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing solutions to complex brand management situations, linking manufacturers and their channels with technological solutions using Golang and MongoDB, among others, to create immersive customer experiences and consumer insights across all devices--big and small, mobile and stationary.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Brought on as the sole developer focused on building a Java-based intranet application and corresponding Android client app to track sales, shifts worked, and provide key performance reporting to all departments of our retail staffing and management company.

Over time, the development team grew to four developers, working to make a fully-custom Ruby on Rails-based intranet application to replace the previous Java application. Key areas covered by the application include importing data from various sources to a single database, point-of-sales entry for salespeople in the field, tracking of time and attendance for employees, calculation of payroll, job applicant tracking for a recruiting call center, client-facing reporting, and myriad reports used in all facets of day-to-day operation within the company.

projects.title: Candidate Tracking System Development for Recruiting Call Center
projects.description:
When you acquire a new client with a major contract to hire thousands of employees over the course of a few months, how do you track them all?

This was a challenge presented to our company in early 2015, and we answered that challenge by developing a system within our internal Ruby on Rails intranet platform to enter and track candidates from first contact all the way through their onboarding and beyond.

Some highlights of the project's capabilities include selecting the nearest open location to the candidate via Bing Maps integration, built-in text messaging capabilities using Twilio, mailers at various points in the hiring process using Postmark, and--of course--reporting for every step along the way.

projects.title: Ground-Up Development of Ruby on Rails Company Intranet Application
projects.description:
With our company having a non-traditional business model, and after surveying several pre-built options such as SalesForce, our company leaders were convinced that the only way to do our intranet the right way was to build it ourselves.

We were previously using a platform based on Java that was pre-made but extensible. This application proved not to meet the requirements of our business, so we began rebuilding the features the way we wanted them using the Ruby on Rails platform.

All departments of the company have a stake in our intranet application, which aims to make the day-to-day management of job applicants, personnel, sales, time and attendance, reporting, media, and communications into a "one-stop shop" built exactly the way we need it to function.

The application is intense and intricate, with (at the time of this writing) around 175 database tables, and we've been focused on keeping the code neat and organized since the beginning of the project to make maintaining the application and adding features to it simple and quick.

Key technologies involved with and integrated into our application include:

* Ruby on Rails
* Test-driven development using Rspec
* Rackspace Cloud Server hosting
* Nginx & Passenger 5 server stack
* Memcached caching
* Foundation
* Postmark
* Twilio
* Bing Maps maps and geocoding
* Capistrano
* DocuSign
* RingCentral
* HAML
* PostgreSQL
* Automated ETL data processing
* Sunspot & Solr global search
* Ransack advanced search
* Codeship continuous integration
* CodeClimate code metrics
* NewRelic monitoring and analytics
